added.summary: Quiet and ghost buttons, which are text on the surface rather than plates, take inks of their own: `--button-quiet-ink`, `--button-quiet-hover-ink`, `--button-quiet-pressed-ink`, `--button-ghost-hover-ink` and `--button-ghost-pressed-ink`. Unset, they fall back to `--button-ink`, `--button-hover-ink` and `--button-pressed-ink` as before, so the default style is unchanged.
